model: pooled logistic; repeated-case random effects not fitted
method_note: The mixed-effects implementation requires the optional statsmodels dependency, absent here. This is an unadjusted pooled logistic slope; repeated-case clustering is not modeled and no inferential p-value is reported.
position_confounded_caveat: Round order was fixed rather than randomized; this association is descriptive and not causal.
read: Pooled descriptive fit only: inspect empirical adoption by round and the method caveat. No mixed-effects inference is reported. NIH baseline accuracy was 1/35 (2.9%).
